description: This Java class 'Controller' acts as an intermediary to update the 'StandaloneMainActivity' based on user interactions with a 'WearableRecyclerView' component, particularly for handling item selection events to update notifications.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Controller class to handle item selection actions and communicate updates to the main activity.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with the main activity instance.

methods.name: itemSelected
methods.description: Method invoked when an item is selected; delegates the call to the main activity to handle notification update.
